CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_accounting_close_certificate(p_kind text, p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT c.value FROM public.accounting_close_certificates c
  WHERE COALESCE(current_setting('app.weekly_accounting_chunked',true),'')='on'
    AND current_setting('app.accounting_close_memo',true)='on'
    AND c.kind=p_kind AND c.union_id=p_union_id AND c.period_start=p_start AND c.period_end=p_end
    AND c.certified_at>=p_end AND c.certified_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '12 hours'
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_accounting_close_certify(p_kind text, p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_value jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF COALESCE(current_setting('app.weekly_accounting_chunked',true),'')<>'on'
  OR current_setting('app.accounting_close_memo',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'on'
  OR p_value IS NULL OR p_end>clock_timestamp() THEN RETURN; END IF;
 DELETE FROM public.accounting_close_certificates WHERE certified_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '8 days';
 INSERT INTO public.accounting_close_certificates(kind,union_id,period_start,period_end,value,certified_at)
 VALUES(p_kind,p_union_id,p_start,p_end,p_value,clock_timestamp())
 ON CONFLICT(kind,union_id,period_start,period_end) DO UPDATE SET value=EXCLUDED.value,certified_at=EXCLUDED.certified_at;
 PERFORM set_config('app.accounting_close_certified','on',true);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_accounting_close_problem(p_kind text, p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_active_maintenance_release_boundary()
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  c_required_steps CONSTANT text[] := ARRAY[
    'sit_out_at','hold_expires_at','addon_period_ends_at','reversible_until',
    'reveal_deadline_at','rebuy_prompt_until','bomb_pot_next_due_at',
    'cash_stay_last_tick_at','cash_rejoin_expires_at','level_started_at',
    'cluster_break_eligible_since','cluster_move_expires_at',
    'reconnect_presence','reconnect_snapshots'
  ];
  v_request_role text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(auth.role(), '')), '');
  v_trusted_database_actor boolean;
  v_release_target timestamptz;
BEGIN
  -- supabase_auth_admin added 2026-09-10: it is GoTrue's own database role
  -- (the signup triggers run as it), never a browser. Without it every signup
  -- wallet trigger raised 42501 here (signup_errors id 9318).
  SELECT session_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role', 'supabase_auth_admin')
         OR COALESCE(r.rolsuper, false)
         -- Supabase CLI session roles may SET ROLE postgres. Trust that
         -- catalog privilege, never a login-name prefix or a JWT workaround.
         OR pg_catalog.pg_has_role(session_user, 'postgres', 'SET')
    INTO v_trusted_database_actor
    FROM (SELECT session_user AS role_name) s
    LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles r ON r.rolname = s.role_name;

  IF v_request_role IS NOT NULL
     AND v_request_role NOT IN ('anon', 'authenticated', 'service_role') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'MAINTENANCE_RELEASE_CERTIFICATE_CALLER_REFUSED'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_request_role IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(v_trusted_database_actor, false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'MAINTENANCE_RELEASE_CERTIFICATE_CALLER_REQUIRED'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- PERF (2026-09-10, swarm A): OFFSET 0 is an optimisation fence. Without it
  -- the planner evaluated `shifted ?& c_required_steps` first on every row of
  -- engine_maintenance_thaws (167 rows, 0 of them contract_version 3) on every
  -- money write that reaches fn_platform_frozen: 229 us -> 32 us per call.
  -- Same four quals, same max(); the jsonb quals now only see rows that already
  -- passed contract_version = 3 AND release_target_at > clock_timestamp().
  SELECT max(t.release_target_at) INTO v_release_target
    FROM (SELECT t.release_target_at, t.shifted
            FROM public.engine_maintenance_thaws t
           WHERE t.contract_version = 3
             AND t.release_target_at > clock_timestamp()
          OFFSET 0) t
   WHERE COALESCE((t.shifted->>'complete')::boolean, false)
     AND t.shifted ?& c_required_steps;
  RETURN v_release_target;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_platform_frozen()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
             FROM public.engine_maintenance_break b
            WHERE b.enforce_freeze
              AND b.announced_at < clock_timestamp() + INTERVAL '30 seconds'
              AND (
                (
                  b.phase = 'last_hand'
                  AND b.break_started_at IS NULL
                  AND b.break_ends_at IS NULL
                  AND b.announced_at + INTERVAL '2 minutes' <= clock_timestamp()
                )
                OR (
                  b.phase = 'counting_down'
                  AND b.break_started_at IS NOT NULL
                  AND b.break_ends_at IS NOT NULL
                  AND b.break_started_at >= b.announced_at
                  AND b.break_ends_at > b.break_started_at
                  AND b.break_ends_at < b.announced_at + INTERVAL '15 minutes'
                )
              )
         )
         OR COALESCE(
           public.fn_active_maintenance_release_boundary() > clock_timestamp(),
           false
         );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_boundary(p_union_id uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE inv jsonb; holdings jsonb:='[]'; issues jsonb:='[]'; s jsonb; t jsonb; f record; tr record;
 lineage jsonb; owned uuid; owners int; initial int; value numeric; entries int; first_op text;
 nonchips boolean; changed boolean; returned numeric; res_club uuid; res_amount numeric; v_proj boolean;
 seat_rows int; seat_value numeric; seat_club uuid; seat_credits int; original_receivables jsonb;
BEGIN
 inv:=public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_as_of_admitted(p_at);
 IF inv->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'observed' THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','inventory',inv,'holdings',holdings); END IF;
 FOR s IN SELECT x->'row' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,table_seats}','[]')) x
  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,tables}','[]')) y
   WHERE y#>>'{row,id}'=x#>>'{row,table_id}' AND y#>>'{row,union_id}'=p_union_id::text) LOOP
  lineage:=public.fn_cash_original_funding_lineage((s->>'user_id')::uuid,(s->>'table_id')::uuid,
   (s->>'id')::uuid,(s->>'occupancy_id')::uuid,(s->>'joined_at')::timestamptz,p_at,true);
  SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.operation_kind='buyin'),count(DISTINCT (r.funding_club_id,r.funding_union_id,r.asset)),min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid
   INTO initial,owners,owned FROM jsonb_array_elements(lineage->'funding_receipts') ref
   JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.id=(ref->>'id')::uuid;
  value:=public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(s->'stack');
  IF lineage->'issues'<>'[]'::jsonb OR initial<>1 OR owners<>1 OR owned IS NULL OR value IS NULL OR value<0 THEN
   issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','cash_boundary_original_funding_missing_or_ambiguous','seat_id',s->'id'));
  ELSE
   holdings:=holdings||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('club_id',owned,'user_id',s->'user_id','amount',value,'kind','cash_stack','source_id',s->'id'));
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Money awaiting the original add-on application is still held for its
 -- original funding account. It must not appear as a poker loss at midnight.
 FOR f IN
  SELECT r.*,r.amount-CASE WHEN COALESCE(af.observed_at,a.applied_at)<p_at THEN a.applied+a.refunded ELSE 0 END AS held
  FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r
  LEFT JOIN public.cash_funding_application_receipts a ON a.funding_receipt_id=r.id
  LEFT JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames rf ON rf.transaction_id=r.transaction_id
  LEFT JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames af ON af.transaction_id=a.transaction_id
  WHERE r.pending_addon_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(rf.observed_at,r.recorded_at)<p_at
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,tables}','[]')) y
    WHERE y#>>'{row,id}'=r.table_id::text AND y#>>'{row,union_id}'=p_union_id::text)
 LOOP
  IF f.held<0 OR f.funding_club_id IS NULL THEN
   issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','pending_funding_boundary_invalid','source_id',f.id));
  ELSIF f.held>0 THEN
   holdings:=holdings||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('club_id',f.funding_club_id,'user_id',f.user_id,'amount',f.held,'kind','pending_cash_funding','source_id',f.id));
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Preserve the established realized-settlement rule: original gross entry
 -- less money already returned is deferred while a tournament remains open.
 -- This is not market value, ICM, or a new allocation of the prize pool.
 -- First inventory operations come from union_pnl_inventory_touches once its
 -- backfill is complete (20260929044303), else from the wide events.
 v_proj:=public.fn_union_pnl_projection_ready('inventory_touches');
 FOR t IN SELECT x->'row' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,tournaments}','[]')) x
  WHERE x#>>'{row,union_id}'=p_union_id::text LOOP
  first_op:=public.fn_union_pnl_first_inventory_operation('tournaments',(t->>'id')::uuid,v_proj);
  -- A tournament captured as the baseline (it existed before the original
  -- inventory capture) is read only when every registration of its original
  -- population carries a valid opening resolution for this boundary
  -- (union_pnl_opening_registration_resolutions: its entry re-proved from the
  -- posted chip ledger, bound to these exact population rows). Otherwise it is
  -- refused exactly as before.
  IF first_op IS DISTINCT FROM 'INSERT' AND (first_op IS DISTINCT FROM 'baseline' OR EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,tournament_players}','[]')) y(x)
    WHERE y.x#>>'{row,tournament_id}'=t->>'id'
     AND public.fn_union_pnl_first_inventory_operation('tournament_players',(y.x#>>'{row,id}')::uuid,v_proj) IS DISTINCT FROM 'INSERT'
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.fn_union_pnl_opening_registration_resolution(p_union_id,p_at,t,y.x->'row')))) THEN
   issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','open_tournament_precedes_original_population','tournament_id',t->'id')); CONTINUE;
  END IF;
  -- One set-based read per open tournament (it was four queries per seat,
  -- two of them full scans of every tournament credit): the same original
  -- entry, instrument, owner-change and returned-credit facts, per
  -- registration, in the population's order.
  FOR s,entries,owners,owned,value,nonchips,changed,returned,res_club,res_amount IN
   WITH players AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT y.x->'row' s,y.o ord,(y.x#>>'{row,id}')::uuid registration_id,(y.x#>>'{row,user_id}')::uuid user_id
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,tournament_players}','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY y(x,o)
    WHERE y.x#>>'{row,tournament_id}'=t->>'id'
   ), credits AS MATERIALIZED (
    -- fn_union_pnl_tournament_returns(t,NULL,NULL,p_at): every credit of this
    -- tournament observed before the boundary; the registration filter that
    -- function applied per call is applied per player below.
    SELECT c.user_id,c.credited_club_id,c.amount,c.entry_receipt_ids,true same_tournament
    FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c
    JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=c.transaction_id
    WHERE c.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND b.observed_at<p_at
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r2.user_id,r2.source_wallet_club_id,r2.amount_paid_now,ARRAY[r.id],false
    FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches r2
    JOIN public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.entitlement_id=r2.entitlement_id
    JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=r2.transaction_id
    WHERE r2.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND b.observed_at<p_at
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c WHERE c.ledger_id=r2.credit_ledger_id)
   ) SELECT p.s,e.entries,e.owners,e.owned,e.value,
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r WHERE r.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND r.registration_id=p.registration_id AND r.asset<>'chips'),
    k.changed,k.returned,rr.owning_club_id,rr.deferred_amount
   FROM players p
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) entries,count(DISTINCT public.fn_union_pnl_tournament_entry_club_of(r.asset,r.amount,r.funding_club_id,r.ledger_id,r.entitlement_id,r.registration_snapshot)) owners,
     min(public.fn_union_pnl_tournament_entry_club_of(r.asset,r.amount,r.funding_club_id,r.ledger_id,r.entitlement_id,r.registration_snapshot)::text)::uuid owned,sum(r.amount) value
    FROM public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r
    JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=r.transaction_id
    WHERE r.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND r.registration_id=p.registration_id AND b.observed_at<p_at AND r.asset='chips') e
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(c.credited_club_id<>e.owned),false) changed,sum(c.amount) returned
    FROM credits c WHERE c.user_id=p.user_id
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r
      WHERE r.registration_id=p.registration_id AND r.id=ANY(c.entry_receipt_ids)
       AND (NOT c.same_tournament OR r.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid))) k
   LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT q.owning_club_id,q.deferred_amount
    FROM public.fn_union_pnl_opening_registration_resolution(p_union_id,p_at,t,p.s) q WHERE first_op='baseline') rr ON true
   ORDER BY p.ord
  LOOP
   -- In a baseline tournament a resolved registration is carried at its
   -- re-proved original entry less its returns before the boundary.
   IF res_club IS NOT NULL THEN
    holdings:=holdings||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('club_id',res_club,'user_id',s->'user_id','amount',res_amount,
     'kind','deferred_tournament_result','source_id',s->'id','basis','opening_registration_resolution'));
    CONTINUE;
   END IF;
   -- A satellite-won seat (20261007001000) has no entry receipt: it was
   -- never charged to a wallet. It is held at the value its one funding row
   -- moved into this prize liability, for the club that funded the seat.
   IF entries=0 AND NOT nonchips AND s->>'source_satellite_id' IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT count(*),sum(l.amount) INTO seat_rows,seat_value FROM public.chip_ledger l
     WHERE l.status='posted' AND l.row_hash IS NOT NULL AND l.created_at<p_at
      AND l.to_type='prize_liability' AND l.to_entity_id=(t->>'id')::uuid
      AND l.metadata->>'registration_id'=s->>'id' AND l.metadata->>'user_id'=s->>'user_id'
      AND ((l.category='tournament_buyin' AND l.from_type='prize_liability' AND l.from_entity_id=(s->>'source_satellite_id')::uuid
        AND l.metadata->>'kind'='satellite_seat_pool_transfer')
       OR (l.category='ticket_redeem' AND l.from_type='escrow' AND l.metadata->>'kind'='tournament_entry_ticket_admission'
        AND l.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=s->>'source_satellite_id'));
    seat_club:=public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner((s->>'id')::uuid,(t->>'id')::uuid);
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c
      JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=c.transaction_id
      WHERE c.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND c.user_id::text=s->>'user_id' AND b.observed_at<p_at)
     +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches r2
      JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=r2.transaction_id
      WHERE r2.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND r2.user_id::text=s->>'user_id' AND b.observed_at<p_at)
     INTO seat_credits;
    IF seat_rows=1 AND seat_value>0 AND seat_club IS NOT NULL AND seat_credits=0 THEN
     holdings:=holdings||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('club_id',seat_club,'user_id',s->'user_id','amount',seat_value,
      'kind','deferred_tournament_result','source_id',s->'id','basis','satellite_seat'));
     CONTINUE;
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF entries=0 OR owners<>1 OR owned IS NULL OR nonchips THEN
    issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','open_tournament_original_instrument_or_earning_club_missing','registration_id',s->'id')); CONTINUE;
   END IF;
   IF changed THEN
    issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','open_tournament_credit_owner_changed','registration_id',s->'id')); CONTINUE;
   END IF;
   value:=value-COALESCE(returned,0);
   holdings:=holdings||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('club_id',owned,'user_id',s->'user_id','amount',value,'kind','deferred_tournament_result','source_id',s->'id'));
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 IF p_union_id='fade0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid AND p_at>='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz THEN
  original_receivables:=smarter_private.original_erased_cash_receivables(p_union_id,p_at);
  IF original_receivables->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' THEN
   issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','original_erased_receivable_unproven','evidence',original_receivables));
  ELSE
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(holdings) existing JOIN jsonb_array_elements(original_receivables->'holdings') owed
    ON existing->>'source_id'=owed->>'source_id') THEN
    issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','original_erased_receivable_double_count_refused'));
   ELSE holdings:=holdings||(original_receivables->'holdings');END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status',CASE WHEN issues='[]'::jsonb THEN 'ready' ELSE 'blocked' END,'boundary',p_at,
  'inventory',inv,'holdings',holdings,'issues',issues,'tournament_basis','original_realized_settlement_deferred_while_open');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_as_of_admitted(p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
AS $function$
DECLARE raw jsonb; remaining jsonb; admitted jsonb;n integer;unique_n integer;h record;current_header record;
BEGIN
 IF p_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_at) OR p_at<>public.fn_union_week_start(p_at) OR p_at>clock_timestamp() THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','closed_original_week_boundary_required');END IF;
 raw:=public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_as_of(p_at);
 -- Missing coverage or an unknown original result is never an empty issue list.
 IF raw IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(raw) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR raw->>'status' NOT IN('observed','blocked') OR raw->>'status' IS NULL
 OR jsonb_typeof(raw->'issues') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(raw->'population') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR (raw->>'status'='blocked' AND raw->'issues'='[]'::jsonb)
 OR (raw->>'status'='observed' AND raw->'issues'<>'[]'::jsonb)
 OR raw ? 'reason'
 OR raw->'inventory_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
 OR raw->'current_state_used' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
 OR raw->'financial_basis_certified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
 OR (raw->>'boundary')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM p_at
 OR nullif(raw->>'capture_started_at','') IS NULL
 OR raw->>'coverage' IS DISTINCT FROM 'Original active population and later captured transitions; monetary funding and obligation receipts must independently certify equity.' THEN
  RETURN (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(raw)='object' THEN raw ELSE '{}'::jsonb END)||jsonb_build_object('status','blocked',
   'admission_status','original_inventory_shape_unproven','financial_basis_certified',false);
 END IF;
 -- A duplicate issue tuple is never two independent original authorities.
 SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(x->>'source_name',x->>'row_id',x->>'source_event_id'))
 INTO n,unique_n FROM jsonb_array_elements(raw->'issues')x;
 IF n IS DISTINCT FROM unique_n THEN RETURN raw||jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','admission_status','duplicate_original_issue_refused');END IF;
 -- Verify the active raw projection against its immutable original sealed
 -- header. This also rejects a forged warm temp-cache population.
 IF p_at>='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz THEN
 SELECT * INTO current_header FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_checkpoints WHERE boundary=p_at;
 IF NOT FOUND OR current_header.result_md5 IS NULL
 OR md5(jsonb_build_object('population',raw->'population','issues',raw->'issues')::text) IS DISTINCT FROM current_header.result_md5
 OR (p_at='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND current_header.result_md5 IS DISTINCT FROM 'dd5e733acc7ed72e69b98d009ac124a6') THEN
 RETURN raw||jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','admission_status','raw_sealed_projection_or_cache_refused');END IF;END IF;
 -- Observed original results require no admission and are returned byte-identical.
 IF raw->>'status'='observed' THEN RETURN raw;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO h FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_checkpoints WHERE boundary='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz;
 IF NOT FOUND OR p_at<'2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz
 OR h.base_boundary IS DISTINCT FROM '2026-10-05 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz
 OR h.max_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM 63116879::bigint OR h.row_count IS DISTINCT FROM 3352453::bigint
 OR h.issue_count IS DISTINCT FROM 245::bigint OR n>245
 OR (p_at='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND n IS DISTINCT FROM 245)
 OR h.rows_md5 IS DISTINCT FROM '5ae24d37326afb43bf598385c2ce24c5'
 OR h.issues_md5 IS DISTINCT FROM '9492245970312d6ac027287a5126c114'
 OR h.result_md5 IS DISTINCT FROM 'dd5e733acc7ed72e69b98d009ac124a6'
 OR h.sealed_at IS DISTINCT FROM '2026-10-12 11:40:53.278694Z'::timestamptz
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM smarter_private.original_inventory_restoration_cases) IS DISTINCT FROM 245::bigint
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM smarter_private.original_inventory_restoration_certificates WHERE boundary='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz) IS DISTINCT FROM 245::bigint
 THEN RETURN raw||jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','admission_status','exact_original_sealed_coverage_refused');END IF;
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(i.issue ORDER BY i.ord) FILTER(WHERE NOT i.accepted),'[]'::jsonb),
        COALESCE(jsonb_agg(i.issue ORDER BY i.ord) FILTER(WHERE i.accepted),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO remaining,admitted
 FROM(SELECT x.issue,x.ord,
   smarter_private.inventory_restoration_issue_accepted(x.issue,p_at) IS TRUE accepted
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(raw->'issues') WITH ORDINALITY x(issue,ord)) i;
 RETURN raw||jsonb_build_object(
  'status',CASE WHEN remaining='[]'::jsonb THEN 'observed' ELSE 'blocked' END,
  'issues',remaining,'retained_original_inventory_issues',raw->'issues',
  'admitted_original_inventory_issues',admitted,
  'raw_inventory_as_of_result_md5',md5(raw::text),'raw_inventory_status',raw->>'status',
  'admission_basis','Exact immutable original restoration boundary certificates; original population untouched',
  'financial_basis_certified',false);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_population(p_base timestamp with time zone, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE population jsonb; gaps jsonb;
BEGIN
 WITH s AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_state(p_base,p_at)
 ), current_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.o_source_name source_name,s.o_row_id row_id,s.o_event_id event_id,s.o_after_row after_row,s.o_first_operation first_operation
  FROM s WHERE s.o_kind='row' AND s.o_after_row IS NOT NULL
 ), active AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM current_rows r WHERE source_name='union_clubs'
   OR (source_name='tables' AND after_row->'tournament_id'='null'::jsonb)
   OR (source_name='table_seats' AND after_row->'left_at'='null'::jsonb)
   OR (source_name='tournaments' AND after_row->>'status' NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'))
   OR (source_name='tournament_players' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM current_rows t WHERE t.source_name='tournaments'
    AND t.row_id::text=r.after_row->>'tournament_id' AND t.after_row->>'status' NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')))
 ), grouped AS (
  SELECT source_name,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_event_id',event_id,'row',after_row) ORDER BY row_id) rows FROM active GROUP BY source_name
 ) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(source_name,rows) FROM grouped),'{}'),
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_name',source_name,'row_id',row_id,'reason','active_row_original_population_missing') ORDER BY source_name,row_id)
   FROM active WHERE first_operation NOT IN ('baseline','INSERT')
    -- A seat vacated before capture began and re-opened afterwards: its first
    -- captured event is the UPDATE that opened this occupancy (see 20260928153000).
    AND NOT (source_name='table_seats' AND first_operation='UPDATE' AND EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT e.before_row FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
       WHERE e.source_name='table_seats' AND e.row_id=active.row_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 1) f
     WHERE f.before_row->>'left_at' IS NOT NULL
      AND (f.before_row->>'left_at')::timestamptz<=(SELECT c.captured_at FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_capture c WHERE c.singleton)))),'[]')
  ||COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_name',s.o_source_name,'row_id',s.o_row_id,'source_event_id',s.o_event_id,'reason','original_inventory_chain_disagrees') ORDER BY s.o_source_name,s.o_row_id,s.o_event_id)
   FROM s WHERE s.o_kind='issue'),'[]') INTO population,gaps;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('population',population,'issues',gaps);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_state(p_base timestamp with time zone, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(o_kind text, o_source_name text, o_row_id uuid, o_event_id bigint, o_first_operation text, o_after_row jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET work_mem TO '64MB'
 SET enable_indexscan TO 'off'
 SET max_parallel_workers_per_gather TO '0'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Plain index scans are off: measured on production 2026-09-28, a cold week
 -- range read through the boundary index one heap page at a time costs
 -- ~235us an event (7.8M events: ~30 min); the same range as a bitmap heap
 -- scan, pages in physical order, ~45us (~6 min), less in parallel.
 IF p_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_at) OR (p_base IS NOT NULL AND (NOT isfinite(p_base) OR p_base>p_at)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_inventory_state_window' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH d AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.source_name sn,e.row_id rid,e.event_id eid,e.operation op,
   jsonb_hash_extended(e.before_row,0) b0,jsonb_hash_extended(e.before_row,1) b1,
   jsonb_hash_extended(e.after_row,0) a0,jsonb_hash_extended(e.after_row,1) a1
  FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
  WHERE e.observed_at>=COALESCE(p_base,'-infinity'::timestamptz) AND e.observed_at<p_at
 ), b AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.source_name sn,r.row_id rid,r.latest_event_id eid,r.first_operation fop,r.after_row,
   jsonb_hash_extended(r.after_row,0) a0,jsonb_hash_extended(r.after_row,1) a1
  FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_published_rows r WHERE r.boundary=p_base
 ), t AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.sn,d.rid,min(d.eid) min_id,max(d.eid) max_id FROM d GROUP BY d.sn,d.rid
 ), x AS MATERIALIZED (
  -- A delta event ordered (by event_id) before the row's last pre-base event:
  -- that row's whole chain is re-read below instead of continued.
  SELECT t.sn,t.rid FROM t JOIN b ON b.sn=t.sn AND b.rid=t.rid WHERE t.min_id<b.eid
 ), w AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.sn,d.rid,d.eid,d.b0,d.b1,
   row_number() OVER p k,lag(d.a0) OVER p pa0,lag(d.a1) OVER p pa1,first_value(d.op) OVER p fop
  FROM d WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE x.sn=d.sn AND x.rid=d.rid)
  WINDOW p AS (PARTITION BY d.sn,d.rid ORDER BY d.eid)
 ), tl AS MATERIALIZED (
  -- The latest row image of each continued row, fetched in one pass in
  -- physical order rather than one random heap read per row.
  SELECT e.event_id eid,e.after_row FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
  WHERE e.event_id=ANY(ARRAY(SELECT t.max_id FROM t WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE x.sn=t.sn AND x.rid=t.rid)))
 ), xh AS MATERIALIZED (
  -- LATERAL: always one identity-index read per interleaved row, never a join
  -- plan that scans the history.
  SELECT e.sn,e.rid,e.eid,e.before_row,e.after_row,
   row_number() OVER p k,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY e.sn,e.rid ORDER BY e.eid DESC) latest,
   lag(e.after_row) OVER p prior_after,first_value(e.op) OVER p fop
  FROM x CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT h.source_name sn,h.row_id rid,h.event_id eid,h.operation op,h.before_row,h.after_row
   FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events h WHERE h.source_name=x.sn AND h.row_id=x.rid AND h.observed_at<p_at) e
  WINDOW p AS (PARTITION BY e.sn,e.rid ORDER BY e.eid)
 )
 SELECT 'row'::text,b.sn,b.rid,b.eid,b.fop,b.after_row FROM b
  WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE t.sn=b.sn AND t.rid=b.rid)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'row',t.sn,t.rid,t.max_id,COALESCE(b.fop,w.fop),tl.after_row
  FROM t JOIN w ON w.sn=t.sn AND w.rid=t.rid AND w.k=1
  JOIN tl ON tl.eid=t.max_id
  LEFT JOIN b ON b.sn=t.sn AND b.rid=t.rid
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'row',xh.sn,xh.rid,xh.eid,xh.fop,xh.after_row FROM xh WHERE xh.latest=1
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',i.source_name,i.row_id,i.event_id,NULL::text,NULL::jsonb FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_published_issues i
  WHERE i.boundary=p_base AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE x.sn=i.source_name AND x.rid=i.row_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',w.sn,w.rid,w.eid,NULL,NULL FROM w WHERE w.k>1 AND (w.pa0,w.pa1) IS DISTINCT FROM (w.b0,w.b1)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',w.sn,w.rid,w.eid,NULL,NULL FROM w JOIN b ON b.sn=w.sn AND b.rid=w.rid
  WHERE w.k=1 AND (b.a0,b.a1) IS DISTINCT FROM (w.b0,w.b1)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',xh.sn,xh.rid,xh.eid,NULL,NULL FROM xh WHERE xh.k>1 AND xh.prior_after IS DISTINCT FROM xh.before_row;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_original_flow_evidence(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(ledger_id uuid, club_id uuid, user_id uuid, buyins numeric, cashouts numeric, kind text, valid boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH originals AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.*,q.ledger_snapshot l,(q.game_scope->>'tournament_id')::uuid tournament_id
  FROM public.union_pnl_original_flows q WHERE q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text
   AND q.recognized_at>=p_start AND q.recognized_at<p_end
 ), rf_original_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.transaction_id,(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid table_id,
   (q.l->>'club_id')::uuid club_id,(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid user_id,(q.l->>'amount')::numeric amount
  FROM originals q
  WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
   AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='player_funding'
 ), rf_original_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT k.transaction_id,k.table_id,k.club_id,k.user_id,k.amount,count(*) refunds,
   min(o.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,min(o.user_id::text)::uuid player
  FROM rf_original_keys k
  JOIN public.cash_funding_application_receipts a ON a.transaction_id=k.transaction_id
   AND a.refunded>0 AND a.refunded=k.amount
  JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts o ON o.id=a.funding_receipt_id
  WHERE a.pending_addon_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.pending_addon_id AND a.original_occupancy_id=o.occupancy_id
   AND o.table_id=k.table_id AND o.account_type='player_wallet' AND o.account_entity_id=k.user_id
   AND o.funding_club_id=k.club_id AND o.user_id=k.user_id
  GROUP BY k.transaction_id,k.table_id,k.club_id,k.user_id,k.amount
 ), matched AS (
  SELECT q.*,f.id cash_funding_id,f.funding_club_id cash_club,f.user_id cash_user,f.amount cash_amount,
   e.id entry_id,e.funding_club_id entry_club,e.user_id entry_user,e.amount entry_amount,
   c.ledger_id credit_id,c.credited_club_id credit_club,c.user_id credit_user,c.amount credit_amount,
   ret.owners,ret.funding_club_id return_club,ret.user_id return_user,mv.moved_club,mv.moved_user,
   COALESCE(rf.refunds,0) refunds,rf.club refund_club,rf.player refund_user,te.refund_ent,te.refund_ent_user,te.refund_ent_club,late.n late_count,late.club late_club,late.player late_user,late.delta late_delta
  FROM originals q
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(*) n,min(p.club_id::text)::uuid club,min(p.user_id::text)::uuid player,min(p.delta) delta
   FROM public.fn_union_pnl_prove_late_settlement(CASE WHEN q.tournament_id IS NULL
    AND q.l->>'category'='settlement' AND q.l->>'idempotency_key' LIKE 'late_seat_settle:%' THEN q.ledger_id END) p
  ) late ON true
  -- One-time filter (20261001): a probe only for the flows that can match.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT f.* FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND f.source_ledger_id=q.ledger_id OFFSET 0) f ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.* FROM public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts e
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND e.ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND e.asset='chips' AND q.tournament_id=e.tournament_id OFFSET 0) e ON true
  -- fn_union_pnl_tournament_returns(q.tournament_id,NULL,p_start,p_end) for
  -- this flow's ledger only: its two branches verbatim, keyed by the ledger.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT c.ledger_id,c.tournament_id,c.user_id,c.credited_club_id,c.amount
   FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c
   JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=c.transaction_id
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND c.ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND c.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND b.observed_at>=p_start AND b.observed_at<p_end
   UNION ALL
   SELECT t.credit_ledger_id,t.tournament_id,t.user_id,t.source_wallet_club_id,t.amount_paid_now
   FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches t
   JOIN public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.entitlement_id=t.entitlement_id
   JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=t.transaction_id
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND t.credit_ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND t.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND b.observed_at>=p_start AND b.observed_at<p_end
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c2 WHERE c2.ledger_id=t.credit_ledger_id)
  ) c ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(DISTINCT (r.funding_club_id,r.user_id)) owners,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid funding_club_id,min(r.user_id::text)::uuid user_id
   FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r
   WHERE r.table_id=(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid AND r.operation_kind='buyin'
    AND q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
    AND r.account_type=q.l->>'to_type' AND r.account_entity_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
    AND r.funding_club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid
    AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i WHERE i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats'
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'occupancy_id'=r.occupancy_id::text
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'table_id'=r.table_id::text)
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_funding_application_receipts a JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts original ON original.id=a.funding_receipt_id
       WHERE a.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND original.occupancy_id=r.occupancy_id AND a.refunded=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric))
  ) ret ON true
  -- A seat cashed out after it arrived by a table move holds chips whose
  -- original buy-in is on the source occupancy, not this one. The occupancy
  -- the cash-out vacated (its seat row in the same original transaction,
  -- carrying exactly the cashed-out stack) is traced through its move receipts
  -- by fn_cash_original_funding_lineage, the proof the boundaries and hands
  -- already use; the owner is its one original buy-in's club and player.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT CASE WHEN lin.v->'issues'='[]'::jsonb AND jsonb_array_length(lin.v->'moves')>0 AND own.receipts>0 AND own.buyins=1
     AND own.clubs=1 AND own.users=1 AND own.club::text=q.l->>'club_id' AND own.player::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id'
     THEN own.club END moved_club,
    CASE WHEN lin.v->'issues'='[]'::jsonb AND jsonb_array_length(lin.v->'moves')>0 AND own.receipts>0 AND own.buyins=1
     AND own.clubs=1 AND own.users=1 AND own.club::text=q.l->>'club_id' AND own.player::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id'
     THEN own.player END moved_user
   FROM (SELECT min(i.before_row::text)::jsonb seat,count(*) n FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i
     WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet'
      AND ret.owners IS DISTINCT FROM 1
      AND i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats' AND i.before_row->>'table_id'=q.l->>'table_id'
      AND i.before_row->>'user_id'=q.l->>'to_entity_id' AND i.before_row->'left_at'='null'::jsonb
      AND i.after_row->>'left_at' IS NOT NULL) s
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.fn_cash_original_funding_lineage((s.seat->>'user_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'table_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'id')::uuid,
     (s.seat->>'occupancy_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'joined_at')::timestamptz,q.recognized_at,false) v) lin
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) receipts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.operation_kind='buyin') buyins,count(DISTINCT r.funding_club_id) clubs,
     count(DISTINCT r.user_id) users,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,min(r.user_id::text)::uuid player
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(lin.v->'funding_receipts') ref JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.id=(ref->>'id')::uuid) own
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND ret.owners IS DISTINCT FROM 1
    AND s.n=1 AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(s.seat->'stack') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (q.l->>'amount')::numeric
  ) mv ON true
  -- A pending add-on returned unapplied is a refund of this player's own
  -- escrowed chips. Its wallet credit can carry no refund category: it runs
  -- inside the hand's post-commit obligations, after atomic_distribute_rake
  -- has declared that transaction's ledger context, so the audit labels it
  -- player_funding under the rake settlement. The application receipt
  -- written in the same transaction proves it: exactly one refund of this
  -- amount from a funding receipt of this player, club and table.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT r.refunds,r.club,r.player FROM rf_original_matches r
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
    AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='player_funding'
    AND r.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND r.table_id=(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid
    AND r.club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
    AND r.amount=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
  ) rf ON true
  -- A seat won in a satellite and later refunded by the target tournament
  -- (cancelled, or the seat released) pays the seat's value back to the
  -- player's wallet from the target's prize liability. That seat was never a
  -- wallet-funded entry of the target, so no tournament credit receipt exists
  -- for it; its proof is the refund entitlement the payout is keyed by: same
  -- tournament, player, wallet club and gross, and the seat's owning club as
  -- resolved from its satellite registration.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT t.id refund_ent,t.user_id refund_ent_user,t.refund_wallet_club_id refund_ent_club
   FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements t
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND t.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND q.l->>'idempotency_key'='tourney:'||t.tournament_id::text||':refund-entitlement:'||t.id::text
    AND t.entitlement_kind IN('satellite_seat','wallet_charge') AND t.gross=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
    AND t.user_id::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id' AND t.refund_wallet_club_id::text=q.l->>'club_id'
    AND q.l->>'from_type'='prize_liability' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='refund'
    AND CASE t.entitlement_kind
     WHEN 'satellite_seat' THEN public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner(t.registration_id,NULL)=t.refund_wallet_club_id
     -- A pre-capture wallet entry refunded by cancellation (20261006154000):
     -- its entitlement's source ledger is the entry proven at the opening
     -- boundary of the refund's own week, for this exact registration, club
     -- and gross.
     WHEN 'wallet_charge' THEN t.source_ledger_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.union_pnl_opening_registration_resolutions r
       WHERE r.boundary=public.fn_union_week_start(q.recognized_at) AND r.union_id=p_union_id AND r.tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND r.user_id=t.user_id
        AND r.owning_club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id AND r.entries=1 AND r.entry_amount=t.gross AND r.returned=0
        AND r.proof_md5=md5(r.proof::text)
        AND r.proof->'entry_ledger' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('ledger_id',t.source_ledger_id::text)))=1
     ELSE false END
  ) te ON true
 ), projected AS (
  SELECT *,CASE WHEN late_count=1 THEN 'cash_late_settlement' WHEN cash_funding_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'cash_funding' WHEN owners=1 OR moved_club IS NOT NULL OR refunds=1 THEN 'cash_return'
    WHEN entry_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'tournament_funding' WHEN credit_id IS NOT NULL OR refund_ent IS NOT NULL THEN 'tournament_return' ELSE 'unsupported' END k,
   COALESCE(late_club,cash_club,CASE WHEN moved_club IS NOT NULL THEN moved_club WHEN owners=1 THEN return_club ELSE refund_club END,entry_club,credit_club,refund_ent_club) owner_club,
   COALESCE(late_user,cash_user,CASE WHEN moved_club IS NOT NULL THEN moved_user WHEN owners=1 THEN return_user ELSE refund_user END,entry_user,credit_user,refund_ent_user) owner_user
  FROM matched
 ) SELECT ledger_id,owner_club,owner_user,
  CASE WHEN k='cash_late_settlement' AND late_delta<0 THEN -late_delta WHEN k IN('cash_funding','tournament_funding') THEN (l->>'amount')::numeric ELSE 0 END,
  CASE WHEN k='cash_late_settlement' AND late_delta>0 THEN late_delta WHEN k IN('cash_return','tournament_return') THEN (l->>'amount')::numeric ELSE 0 END,k,
  (l->>'status'='posted' AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(l->'amount')>0 AND owner_club IS NOT NULL AND owner_user IS NOT NULL
   AND owner_club::text=l->>'club_id' AND game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND CASE k
    WHEN 'cash_late_settlement' THEN late_count=1 AND abs(late_delta)=(l->>'amount')::numeric
    WHEN 'cash_funding' THEN cash_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric AND l->>'to_type'='table_stack' AND l->>'category' IN('buyin','rebuy','addon','horse_funding')
    WHEN 'cash_return' THEN (owners=1 OR moved_club IS NOT NULL OR (refunds=1 AND l->>'category'='player_funding')) AND l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND (l->>'category' IN('cashout','table_cashout','refund')
     OR (l->>'category'='player_funding' AND refunds=1 AND refund_club=owner_club AND refund_user=owner_user))
    WHEN 'tournament_funding' THEN entry_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric AND l->>'to_type'='prize_liability' AND l->>'category' IN('tournament_buyin','rebuy','addon')
    WHEN 'tournament_return' THEN (credit_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric OR (credit_id IS NULL AND refund_ent IS NOT NULL)) AND l->>'from_type'='prize_liability' AND l->>'category' IN('tournament_prize','prize','bounty','refund','tournament_refund')
    ELSE false END) IS TRUE
 FROM projected
 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM smarter_private.original_restoration_cash_returns(p_union_id,p_start,p_end)
 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM smarter_private.original_erased_cash_discharge_returns(p_union_id,p_start,p_end);
$function$;

  SELECT e.after_row r FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
  WHERE e.source_name='tournament_players' AND e.row_id=p_registration_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 1
 ), who AS (
  SELECT (r->>'user_id')::uuid user_id,(r->>'source_satellite_id')::uuid satellite_id,(r->>'registered_at')::timestamptz registered_at,
   (r->>'tournament_id')::uuid target_id

 ), award AS (
  SELECT a.tournament_id,a.user_id FROM who w
  JOIN public.tournament_satellite_awards a ON a.tournament_id=w.satellite_id AND a.user_id=w.user_id
  JOIN public.tournament_satellite_settlements s ON s.tournament_id=a.tournament_id AND s.target_id=w.target_id
  WHERE (a.delivery_kind='seat' AND a.registration_id=p_registration_id)

     AND t.status='redeemed' AND t.redemption_mode='tournament_entry_only' AND t.redeemed_at=w.registered_at))
 ), entry AS (
  SELECT count(*) n,count(DISTINCT r.funding_club_id) clubs,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.operation='entry') entries,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.asset IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips' OR r.amount IS NULL OR r.amount<=0 OR r.funding_club_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(

  FROM award a JOIN public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.tournament_id=a.tournament_id AND r.user_id=a.user_id
 )
 SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM award)=1 AND e.n>0 AND e.entries>=1 AND e.clubs=1 AND e.bad=0 THEN e.club END FROM entry e

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_closed_player_proof(f jsonb, lo timestamp with time zone, hi timestamp with time zone)

 owner uuid;term jsonb;entry_ledger jsonb;
BEGIN
 e:=f->'event';prior:=f->'prior';b:=e->'before_row';t:=f#>'{parent,after_row}';
 IF f IS NULL OR lo IS NULL OR hi IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(b) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR e->>'source_name' IS DISTINCT FROM 'tournament_players'
 OR jsonb_typeof(prior->'after_row') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR b-ARRAY['status','eliminated_at'] IS DISTINCT FROM (prior->'after_row')-ARRAY['status','eliminated_at']
 OR b->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'eliminated' OR b->>'eliminated_at' IS NULL
 OR (b->>'eliminated_at')::timestamptz NOT BETWEEN '2026-10-06 15:33:00Z' AND '2026-10-06 15:33:10Z'
 OR (prior->>'event_id')::bigint >= (e->>'event_id')::bigint
 OR lo >= (b->>'eliminated_at')::timestamptz OR hi <= (e->>'observed_at')::timestamptz
 OR f#>>'{parent,source_name}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'tournaments'
 OR f#>>'{parent,row_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id' OR t->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id'
 OR f#>>'{parent,observed_at}' IS NULL OR (f#>>'{parent,observed_at}')::timestamptz>=hi
 OR t->>'status' NOT IN('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') OR t->>'status' IS NULL
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_closed_interval_or_value_refused');END IF;
 IF t->>'status'='COMPLETED' THEN
  term:=smarter_private.original_closed_tournament_rails_proof(f->'terminal_fixture',hi);
  IF term->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' OR term->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id'
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_terminal_rails_refused');END IF;
  IF b->>'source_satellite_id' IS NOT NULL THEN
   owner:=public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner((b->>'id')::uuid,(b->>'tournament_id')::uuid);

   fund:=f#>'{entry_funding,0,receipt}';ledger:=f#>'{entry_funding,0,ledger}';

   OR (fund->>'amount')::numeric IS NULL OR (fund->>'amount')::numeric<=0
   OR fund->>'ledger_id' IS DISTINCT FROM ledger->>'id' OR ledger->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'
   OR ledger->>'row_hash' IS NULL OR ledger->>'from_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet'
   OR ledger->>'from_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id' OR ledger->>'to_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'prize_liability'
   OR ledger->>'to_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id' OR ledger->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM fund->>'funding_club_id'
   OR (ledger->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (fund->>'amount')::numeric THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_entry_debit_refused');END IF;
   owner:=(fund->>'funding_club_id')::uuid;
  END IF;
  IF owner IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_entry_owner_unproven');END IF;
 ELSE
  c:=f->'cancellation';
  IF jsonb_typeof(c) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR c->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id'
  OR c->'receipt_version' NOT IN('2'::jsonb,'3'::jsonb) OR c->>'receipt_version' IS NULL
  OR c#>'{receipt,ok}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR c#>'{receipt,fully_settled}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR c->>'settled_at' IS NULL OR c->>'escrow_closed_at' IS NULL
  OR (c->>'settled_at')::timestamptz>=hi OR (c->>'escrow_closed_at')::timestamptz>=hi
  OR NOT(c->'refunded_registration_ids' ? (b->>'id')) THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_cancellation_refused');END IF;
  IF jsonb_typeof(f->'entry_funding') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(f->'entry_funding')<>1 THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_cancelled_entry_missing');END IF;
  fund:=f#>'{entry_funding,0,receipt}';entry_ledger:=f#>'{entry_funding,0,ledger}';
  IF fund->>'registration_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'id' OR fund->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id'
  OR fund->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id' OR fund->>'asset' IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips'
  OR (fund->>'amount')::numeric IS NULL OR (fund->>'amount')::numeric<=0
  OR fund->>'ledger_id' IS DISTINCT FROM entry_ledger->>'id' OR entry_ledger->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'
  OR entry_ledger->>'row_hash' IS NULL OR entry_ledger->>'from_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet'
  OR entry_ledger->>'from_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id' OR entry_ledger->>'to_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'prize_liability'
  OR entry_ledger->>'to_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id'
  OR entry_ledger->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM fund->>'funding_club_id'
  OR (entry_ledger->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (fund->>'amount')::numeric THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_cancelled_entry_debit_refused');END IF;
  SELECT r INTO refund FROM jsonb_array_elements(c#>'{receipt,refunds}') r WHERE r->>'registration_id'=b->>'id';
  ledger:=f->'refund_ledger';wallet:=f->'refund_wallet';
  IF refund IS NULL OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(c#>'{receipt,refunds}')r WHERE r->>'registration_id'=b->>'id')<>1
  OR refund->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id' OR refund->>'credit_ledger_id' IS DISTINCT FROM ledger->>'id'
  OR refund->>'source_wallet_club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM fund->>'funding_club_id'
  OR refund->>'entitlement_id' IS DISTINCT FROM fund->>'entitlement_id'
  OR (refund->>'gross_paid')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (fund->>'amount')::numeric
  OR refund->>'wallet_transaction_id' IS DISTINCT FROM wallet->>'id'
  OR ledger->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted' OR ledger->>'row_hash' IS NULL
  OR ledger->>'to_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet' OR ledger->>'to_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id'
  OR ledger->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM refund->>'source_wallet_club_id'
  OR (ledger->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (refund->>'amount_paid_now')::numeric
  OR (wallet->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (refund->>'amount_paid_now')::numeric
  OR wallet->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id' OR wallet->>'type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'credit'

  OR (refund->>'amount_paid_now')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (refund->>'gross_paid')::numeric
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_refund_delivery_refused');END IF;
  owner:=(refund->>'source_wallet_club_id')::uuid;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ready','financial_admission',false,'event_id',e->'event_id','source_name','tournament_players',
 'original_owner',owner,'original_closed_held',0,'original_state_hashes_preserved',true,'missing_force_event_invented',false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','malformed_original');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_closed_tournament_rails_proof(f jsonb, hi timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE terminal jsonb;pay jsonb;credit jsonb;ledger jsonb;amount numeric;total numeric:=0;n integer:=0;
BEGIN
 terminal:=f->'terminal';
 IF f IS NULL OR hi IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(terminal) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR terminal->'receipt_version' NOT IN('2'::jsonb,'3'::jsonb)
 OR terminal->>'receipt_version' IS NULL OR terminal->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'tournament_id'
 OR terminal->>'accounting_state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'recognized'
 OR terminal#>'{cash_receipt,fully_settled}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
 OR terminal#>'{cash_receipt,ok}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
 OR terminal->>'completed_at' IS NULL OR terminal->>'settled_at' IS NULL OR terminal->>'escrow_closed_at' IS NULL
 OR (terminal->>'completed_at')::timestamptz>=hi OR (terminal->>'settled_at')::timestamptz>=hi
 OR (terminal->>'escrow_closed_at')::timestamptz>=hi
 OR jsonb_typeof(f->'payouts') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_typeof(f->'credits') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(f->'ledgers') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_array_length(f->'payouts') IS DISTINCT FROM (terminal->>'cash_payout_count')::integer
 OR jsonb_array_length(f->'payouts') IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(f->'credits')
 OR jsonb_array_length(f->'payouts') IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(f->'ledgers')
 OR f->'diamond_rail_count' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'::jsonb OR f->'satellite_rail_count' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'::jsonb
 OR (terminal->>'cash_payout_total')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (terminal->>'prize_pool')::numeric
 OR (terminal->>'bounty_payout_total')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (terminal->>'bounty_pool')::numeric
 OR (terminal->>'bounty_pool')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_terminal_or_asset_refused');END IF;
 FOR pay IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'payouts') LOOP
  amount:=(pay->>'amount')::numeric;
  IF amount IS NULL OR amount<=0 OR amount*100<>trunc(amount*100)
  OR pay->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'tournament_id'
  OR pay->>'paid_at' IS NULL OR (pay->>'paid_at')::timestamptz>=hi
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(terminal#>'{cash_receipt,payouts}') p
   WHERE p->>'user_id'=pay->>'user_id' AND (p->>'amount')::numeric=amount)
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_payout_refused');END IF;
  SELECT c INTO credit FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'credits') c
  WHERE c->>'user_id'=pay->>'user_id' AND c->>'tournament_id'=f->>'tournament_id' AND (c->>'amount')::numeric=amount;
  IF credit IS NULL OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'credits') c
   WHERE c->>'user_id'=pay->>'user_id' AND c->>'tournament_id'=f->>'tournament_id' AND (c->>'amount')::numeric=amount)<>1
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_credit_ambiguous');END IF;
  SELECT l INTO ledger FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'ledgers')l WHERE l->>'id'=credit->>'ledger_id';
  IF ledger IS NULL OR ledger->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted' OR ledger->>'row_hash' IS NULL
  OR ledger->>'from_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'prize_liability' OR ledger->>'from_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'tournament_id'
  OR ledger->>'to_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet' OR ledger->>'to_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM pay->>'user_id'
  OR ledger->>'category' IS DISTINCT FROM 'tournament_prize' OR (ledger->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM amount
  OR ledger->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM credit->>'credited_club_id'
  OR ledger->>'created_at' IS NULL OR (ledger->>'created_at')::timestamptz>=hi
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_posted_prize_refused');END IF;
  total:=total+amount;n:=n+1;
 END LOOP;
 IF total IS DISTINCT FROM (terminal->>'cash_payout_total')::numeric THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_pool_not_conserved');END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ready','financial_admission',false,'tournament_id',f->'tournament_id',
 'original_prize_rows',n,'original_pool',total,'all_actual_rails_checked',true,'raw_history_rewritten',false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','malformed_original');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_paired_seat_restoration_proof(f jsonb, tp jsonb, lo timestamp with time zone, hi timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE ready jsonb;b jsonb;p jsonb;a jsonb;q jsonb;
BEGIN
 ready:=smarter_private.original_retirement_boundary_proof(tp,lo,hi);
 IF ready->'ready' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_hand_refused');END IF;
 b:=f#>'{next,before_row}';p:=f#>'{prior,after_row}';a:=f#>'{next,after_row}';q:=f#>'{qualification,row}';
 IF f IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(b) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(p) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(a) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR b-'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM p-'left_at' OR p->'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
 OR a-'left_at'-'occupancy_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b-'left_at'-'occupancy_id'
 OR a->'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR a->>'occupancy_id' IS NULL
 OR a->>'occupancy_id'=b->>'occupancy_id'
 OR f#>>'{next,transaction_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM tp#>>'{restoration,transaction_id}'
 OR f->'qualification' IS DISTINCT FROM tp->'qualification'
 OR b->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM q#>>'{seat,id}' OR b->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM q->>'user_id'
 OR b->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM tp#>>'{qualification,table_id}'
 OR b->>'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM q#>>'{seat,left_at}'
 OR (b->>'stack')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (q#>>'{stack,stack_before}')::numeric
 OR (b->>'joined_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (q#>>'{seat,joined_at}')::timestamptz
 OR b->>'occupancy_id' IS DISTINCT FROM q#>>'{seat,occupancy_id}'
 OR (f#>>'{prior,event_id}')::bigint >= (f#>>'{next,event_id}')::bigint
 OR lo>=(b->>'left_at')::timestamptz OR hi<=(f#>>'{next,observed_at}')::timestamptz
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','exact_original_seat_or_interval_refused');END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ready','financial_admission',false,'source_name','table_seats','event_id',f#>'{next,event_id}',
 'original_monetary_stack_unchanged',true,'signed_original_hand_preserved',true,'raw_history_rewritten',false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','malformed_original');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_restoration_cash_returns(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(ledger_id uuid, club_id uuid, user_id uuid, buyins numeric, cashouts numeric, kind text, valid boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE c record;f jsonb;p jsonb;t jsonb;l jsonb;scope jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_union_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'fade0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid THEN RETURN;END IF;
 IF p_start IS NULL OR p_end IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_start) OR NOT isfinite(p_end) OR p_end<=p_start THEN RETURN;END IF;
 FOR c IN SELECT k.* FROM smarter_private.original_inventory_restoration_cases k
 JOIN smarter_private.original_inventory_restoration_certificates z USING(event_id)
 WHERE k.family='returned_cash' AND z.boundary='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'
 AND z.witness_md5=k.witness_md5 AND z.proof_md5=md5(z.proof::text)
 AND z.original_witness=k.original_witness LOOP
  IF (c.original_witness#>>'{original_chip_transaction,created_at}')::timestamptz<p_start OR (c.original_witness#>>'{original_chip_transaction,created_at}')::timestamptz>=p_end THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  f:=smarter_private.original_inventory_finite_witness(c.event_id);
  IF f IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_restoration_cash_flow_source_refused' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  p:=smarter_private.original_returned_cash_base_proof(f,'2026-10-05 07:00:00Z','2026-10-12 07:00:00Z');
  t:=f->'original_chip_transaction';l:=f->'base_ledger';scope:=f->'original_table_scope';
  IF p->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' OR p->'financial_admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR scope->>'union_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_union_id::text OR scope->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM f#>>'{event,before_row,table_id}'
  OR scope->'is_private' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR scope->'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
  OR f#>>'{original_manifest_scope,asset}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips'
  OR f#>'{original_manifest_scope,unit_scale}' IS DISTINCT FROM '2'::jsonb
  OR f#>>'{original_manifest_scope,game_union_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM p_union_id::text
  OR f#>'{original_manifest_scope,tournament_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
  OR t->>'transaction_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'seat_credit_restored'
  OR t#>>'{metadata,restore_key}' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'restore_key'
  OR t->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM scope->>'id' OR t->>'to_user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'original_user'
  OR t->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'original_owner'
  OR t->'is_reversed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR t->'clawed_back' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR (t->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (p->>'original_base_returned')::numeric
  OR (t->>'created_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (f#>>'{base_mint,created_at}')::timestamptz
  OR (t->>'created_at')::timestamptz<p_start OR (t->>'created_at')::timestamptz>=p_end
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_original_flows old WHERE old.ledger_id=(l->>'id')::uuid)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_restoration_cash_flow_proof_refused' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  ledger_id:=(l->>'id')::uuid;club_id:=(p->>'original_owner')::uuid;user_id:=(p->>'original_user')::uuid;
  buyins:=0;cashouts:=(p->>'original_base_returned')::numeric;kind:='cash_return';valid:=true;RETURN NEXT;
 END LOOP;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_retirement_boundary_proof(f jsonb, lo timestamp with time zone, hi timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 a jsonb:=f#>'{prior,after_row}'; b jsonb:=f#>'{next,before_row}';
 z jsonb:=f#>'{next,after_row}'; q jsonb:=f->'qualification';
 r jsonb:=f->'restoration'; s jsonb:=f#>'{retained,original_submission}';
 roster jsonb:=q#>'{row,roster}'; seat jsonb:=q#>'{row,seat}';
 original_stack jsonb:=q#>'{row,stack}'; t timestamptz;
 committed jsonb:=f->'atomic_commit';
BEGIN
 IF f IS NULL OR lo IS NULL OR hi IS NULL OR lo>=hi OR a IS NULL OR b IS NULL OR z IS NULL
 OR q IS NULL OR r IS NULL OR s IS NULL OR roster IS NULL OR seat IS NULL OR original_stack IS NULL OR committed IS NULL THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','missing_original_witness');
 END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(f) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(a) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(b) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(z) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(q) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(r) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(s) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(roster) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(seat) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(original_stack) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(committed) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','malformed_original_structure');
 END IF;
 IF committed->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM q->>'submission_id'
 OR committed->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM q->>'table_id'
 OR committed->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM q->>'hand_number'
 OR committed->'post_commit_completed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
 OR committed->>'post_commit_ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
 OR committed->>'row_md5' IS NULL OR committed->>'row_md5' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','original_atomic_completion_unproven');
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(q) e WHERE e.value='null'::jsonb)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(r) e WHERE e.value='null'::jsonb)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(s) e WHERE e.value='null'::jsonb)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['id','user_id','tournament_id','club_id']) k
    WHERE nullif(a->>k,'') IS NULL)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['id','user_id','club_id','table_id','occupancy_id','joined_at']) k
    WHERE nullif(seat->>k,'') IS NULL)
 OR f#>>'{prior,event_id}' IS NULL OR f#>>'{next,event_id}' IS NULL
 OR f#>>'{prior,observed_at}' IS NULL OR f#>>'{next,observed_at}' IS NULL
 OR f#>>'{next,transaction_id}' IS NULL THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','null_original_authority');
 END IF;
 IF NOT(a ?& ARRAY['id','user_id','tournament_id','club_id','prize','bounty_winnings','status','eliminated_at'])
 OR NOT(roster ?& ARRAY['id','user_id','tournament_id','chips','position','prize','status','eliminated_at'])
 OR NOT(seat ?& ARRAY['id','user_id','club_id','table_id','occupancy_id','stack','joined_at'])
 OR NOT(original_stack ?& ARRAY['seat_id','user_id','seat_joined_at','stack_before'])
 OR jsonb_typeof(roster->'chips') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR jsonb_typeof(seat->'stack') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR jsonb_typeof(original_stack->'stack_before') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR NOT(q ?& ARRAY['submission_id','table_id','tournament_id','hand_number','request_hash','qualification_hash'])
 OR NOT(r ?& ARRAY['submission_id','request_hash','qualification_hash','original_generation','successor_generation','transaction_id','restored_at','restored_players'])
 OR NOT(s ?& ARRAY['submission_id','request_hash','table_id','hand_number','lease_generation','stacks','started_at'])
 OR jsonb_typeof(f#>'{retained,expected,rows}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(s->'stacks') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','missing_original_field');
 END IF;
 t:=(b->>'eliminated_at')::timestamptz;
 -- The interval endpoints may never cross the unrecorded transient state.
 IF t IS NULL OR NOT(lo<t AND greatest((r->>'restored_at')::timestamptz,(f#>>'{next,observed_at}')::timestamptz)<hi)
 OR NOT((f#>>'{prior,observed_at}')::timestamptz<t AND t<(r->>'restored_at')::timestamptz
 AND t<(f#>>'{next,observed_at}')::timestamptz)
 OR (f#>>'{prior,event_id}')::bigint>=(f#>>'{next,event_id}')::bigint THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','boundary_or_chronology_unproven');
 END IF;
 IF a IS DISTINCT FROM z OR (a-ARRAY['status','eliminated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (b-ARRAY['status','eliminated_at'])
 OR a->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'playing' OR a->'eliminated_at' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
 OR b->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'eliminated' OR (a->>'prize')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0
 OR (a->>'bounty_winnings')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (roster->>'bounty_winnings')::numeric
 OR (a->>'id',a->>'user_id',a->>'tournament_id') IS DISTINCT FROM
    (roster->>'id',roster->>'user_id',roster->>'tournament_id')
 OR roster->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'status' OR roster->>'eliminated_at' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'eliminated_at'
 OR roster->'position' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR (roster->>'prize')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0
 OR (roster->>'chips')::numeric<=0 OR roster->>'chips' IS DISTINCT FROM seat->>'stack'
 OR roster->>'chips' IS DISTINCT FROM original_stack->>'stack_before'
 OR original_stack->>'seat_id' IS DISTINCT FROM seat->>'id'
 OR original_stack->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'user_id'
 OR original_stack->>'seat_joined_at' IS DISTINCT FROM seat->>'joined_at'
 OR seat->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'user_id' OR seat->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'club_id'
 OR seat->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM q->>'table_id' OR seat->>'occupancy_id' IS NULL THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','original_value_or_ownership_changed');
 END IF;
 IF q->>'submission_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r->>'submission_id'
 OR q->>'submission_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'submission_id'
 OR q->>'request_hash' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'request_hash'
 OR q->>'request_hash' IS DISTINCT FROM r->>'request_hash'
 OR q->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'table_id' OR q->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'hand_number'
 OR q->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'tournament_id'
 OR r->>'original_generation' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'lease_generation'
 OR r->>'successor_generation' IS NULL OR r->>'successor_generation'=r->>'original_generation'
 OR r->>'transaction_id' IS DISTINCT FROM f#>>'{next,transaction_id}'
 OR q->>'qualification_hash' IS DISTINCT FROM r->>'qualification_hash'
 OR md5((f#>'{retained,expected}')::text) IS DISTINCT FROM r->>'qualification_hash'
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(f#>'{retained,expected,rows}') e WHERE e=q->'row')<>1
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(s->'stacks') e WHERE e=original_stack)<>1
 OR (r->>'restored_players')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(f#>'{retained,expected,rows}')
 OR NOT((s->>'started_at')::timestamptz<greatest((r->>'restored_at')::timestamptz,(f#>>'{next,observed_at}')::timestamptz))
 OR NOT(t BETWEEN '2026-10-06 15:33:04Z'::timestamptz AND '2026-10-06 15:33:08Z'::timestamptz) THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','original_restoration_not_bound');
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',true,'proof_class','original_tournament_restoration_cycle',
 'financial_admission',false,'original_force_transaction','not_retained',
 'prior_event',f#>'{prior,event_id}','restoration_event',f#>'{next,event_id}',
 'original_row_hash',md5(a::text),'forced_row_hash',md5(b::text),
 'original_qualification_hash',r->>'qualification_hash','from',lo,'until',hi);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR datetime_field_overflow THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','malformed_original_witness');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_returned_cash_base_proof(f jsonb, lo timestamp with time zone, hi timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE e jsonb;p jsonb;b jsonb;x jsonb;s jsonb;l jsonb;m jsonb;w jsonb;native jsonb;uid text;club text;base numeric;
BEGIN
 e:=f->'event';p:=f->'prior';b:=e->'before_row';x:=f->'original_participant';s:=x->'stack';
 l:=f->'base_ledger';m:=f->'base_mint';w:=f->'base_idempotency';native:=f->'native';
 IF f IS NULL OR lo IS NULL OR hi IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(b) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR e->>'source_name' IS DISTINCT FROM 'table_seats' OR e->>'operation' NOT IN('UPDATE','DELETE') OR e->>'operation' IS NULL
 OR jsonb_typeof(p->'after_row') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR b-'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM (p->'after_row')-'left_at'
 OR p#>'{after_row,left_at}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR b->>'left_at' IS NULL
 OR (b->>'left_at')::timestamptz NOT BETWEEN '2026-10-06 15:33:00Z' AND '2026-10-06 15:33:10Z'
 OR (p->>'event_id')::bigint >= (e->>'event_id')::bigint
 OR lo>=(b->>'left_at')::timestamptz OR hi<=(e->>'observed_at')::timestamptz
 OR b->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'seat_id' OR b->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'user_id'
 OR b->>'occupancy_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'occupancy_id'
 OR (b->>'joined_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (s->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz
 OR jsonb_typeof(b->'stack') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR jsonb_typeof(s->'stack_before') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR (b->>'stack')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (s->>'stack_before')::numeric OR (b->>'stack')::numeric<=0
 OR x#>'{manifest_participant,funding_lineage,issues}' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR jsonb_typeof(x#>'{manifest_participant,funding_receipts}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_array_length(x#>'{manifest_participant,funding_receipts}')=0
 OR native#>>'{stack_result,success}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
 OR native#>>'{stack_result,conservation_checked}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
 OR native#>>'{post_commit_result,ok}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
 OR native->>'post_commit_completed_at' IS NULL OR (native->>'post_commit_completed_at')::timestamptz>=hi
 OR native#>>'{stack_result,table_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'table_id'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(native#>'{stack_result,request,stacks}') ns
  WHERE ns->>'seat_id'=s->>'seat_id' AND ns->>'user_id'=s->>'user_id'
  AND (ns->>'stack_before')::numeric=(s->>'stack_before')::numeric AND (ns->>'stack')::numeric=(s->>'stack')::numeric
  AND (ns->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz=(s->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz)
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_returned_cash_identity_refused');END IF;
 uid:=s->>'user_id';club:=x->>'funding_club_id';base:=(s->>'stack_before')::numeric;
 IF f ? 'custody' AND (f#>>'{custody,state}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'consumed'
 OR f#>>'{custody,original_inventory_event}' IS DISTINCT FROM e->>'event_id'
 OR f#>>'{custody,user_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM uid OR f#>>'{custody,occupancy_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'occupancy_id'
 OR f#>>'{custody,funding_club_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM club OR f#>>'{custody,restore_key}' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'restore_key'
 OR (f#>>'{custody,stack_before}')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM base
 OR (f#>>'{custody,stack_after}')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (s->>'stack')::numeric
 OR f#>>'{custody,issuance_ledger}' IS DISTINCT FROM l->>'id') THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_consumed_custody_refused');END IF;
 IF club IS NULL OR f->>'restore_key' IS NULL OR l->>'idempotency_key' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'restore_key'
 OR l->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted' OR l->>'row_hash' IS NULL
 OR l->>'from_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'issuance_reserve' OR l->>'to_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet'
 OR l->>'to_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM uid OR l->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM club OR l->>'category' IS DISTINCT FROM 'refund'
 OR (l->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM base OR l->>'created_at' IS NULL
 OR (l->>'created_at')::timestamptz<=(b->>'left_at')::timestamptz OR (l->>'created_at')::timestamptz>=hi
 OR m->>'op_id' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'restore_key' OR m->>'chip_ledger_id' IS DISTINCT FROM l->>'id'
 OR m->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mint' OR m->>'asset' IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips'
 OR m->>'holder_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player' OR m->>'holder_id' IS DISTINCT FROM uid
 OR (m->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM base
 OR w->>'key' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'restore_key' OR w->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM uid
 OR (w->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM base
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_returned_cash_receipts_refused');END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ready','financial_admission',false,'event_id',e->'event_id',
 'original_base_returned',base,'original_owner',club,'original_user',uid,'new_payment',false,
 'preserved_signed_delta',(s->>'stack')::numeric-base,'original_closed_held',0,'raw_history_rewritten',false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','malformed_original');
END $function$
